# Twemoji test artwork

These 12 unmodified SVG graphics are Twemoji artwork by Twitter, Inc. and other
contributors, from the [jdecked/twemoji v15.1.0 release](https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji/tree/v15.1.0),
pinned to commit `7407fa31c51be5ab45626b8ab5554d50cc8073f6`.

The artwork is licensed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
The complete license is in `LICENSE-CC-BY-4.0.txt`. Attribution must accompany copies.
They are used only in tests and are not included in the npm package. No artwork changes
were made.
